name: Fx
lead: Particles for a room: Minecraft's particle packet; the `fx` global, or `room.fx`.

functions.name: particle
functions.signature: fx.particle(name: string, pos: Vec3 | { Vec3 }, opts: { count: number ?, spread: (number | Vec3)?, velocity: Vec3 ?, speed: number ?, color: Ink ?, size: number ?, }?)
functions.description: Shows particle `name` ("dust", "end_rod", "explosion", "firework", "flame", "note", "totem_of_undying") at `pos`, or at every point of a list. Each point reaches players in the room within 64 blocks of its origin in 3D, including the boundary, before spread or velocity. `count` (1) at each point in a box `spread` (0) out; or with `velocity`, one particle moving along it (`speed` 1 then, else 0). `color` and `size` are for dust only.
